name: Wintermute USDC Select
oneLiner: armUSDCs is Wintermute's USDC lending vault on Ethereum; shares redeem at NAV when liquidity is available and bear strategy losses.
collateral: USDC lender positions in six Morpho markets secured by cbBTC, WBTC, wstETH and principal-token collateral
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares accrue lending interest and realize losses against USDC; direct redemption uses idle USDC and a configured liquidity adapter, subject to market liquidity. In-kind deallocation retains underlying lending-position exposure.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Wintermute USDC Select at ethereum:0xa2eaad0d586cf9fd73bb2c09cf6a7e3e187d68cd is an ERC-4626 share over USDC with a code-enforced pro-rata claim on the current Morpho lending inventory. The claim bears lending losses and liquidity constraints, so protocol-position intentionally differs from the fiat-cash parent and older Morpho precedents. At ethereum block 26107703 (0x18e5f37), captured 2026-10-02T22:44:09.665742+00:00, totalSupply=44986944522361979656587662 atomic shares; accrueInterestView returned assets=45890229418936, pending performance shares=0, pending management shares=0. Idle USDC=0; complete adapter inventory sums to 45890229418936 USDC atomic units. Asset decimals=6, share decimals=18. convertToAssets(1e18)=1020078 USDC atomic units.
